Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.client

package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.client
Client-side API for the local player, from CozyVoiceApi.client().

Side: physical client only. Do not load these classes from common code that also runs on a dedicated server without a DistExecutor/FMLEnvironment.dist guard. Threads: getters are thread-safe; setters and screen methods must run on the client thread.

Related events: net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event.client.

Since:
1.1.0
